## Specific task description

Task instruction: Move the bowl for holding items onto the top of the smooth round plate for serving.

Task description: Move the light-colored bowl currently to the right of the light-colored round plate onto the plate.

Success criteria: The bowl has been placed on the plate with their horizontal positions close and lowered enough to be supported by the plate; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider a rim section facing the robot with ample surrounding clearance, with one finger inside and one outside to grip the upper bowl wall. Match the opening to wall thickness and approach clearance, avoiding surrounding objects when spanning the whole bowl mouth.
- Before closing, check that the fingers are actually on the inside and outside of the bowl wall, with the pads extending below the rim and contacting enough of the wall. Avoid merely overlapping in the image while only pushing the rim and moving the bowl.
- Keep the bowl opening upward during transport and lift its base high enough to clear the plate rim, avoiding rim contact that could tilt or slip it.
- Lower the bowl slightly during placement, confirm the plate supports its base, then release. Leave room for the inner finger to withdraw upward through the bowl opening, avoiding a drop or moving the bowl during withdrawal.
